title: Fill against a running stitch on a 40 mm square
description: #955: the #471 baseline square (40 mm outline, Fill 4.5 lines/mm at 45 degrees with under sewing) with running stitch, pitch 2.0 mm, 1 time. PE-DESIGN's fill reaches the outline whatever the line (2,413 stitches, 40 x 40 mm in every case) and a zigzag is centred on it, so the design is 40 mm plus the zigzag's width; OpenStitch's the same.

references.make: Open compat/reference/stitches/stamp-plain-square-baseline.pes's design in PE-DESIGN 11.50 (or draw it again: a 40 mm square with the rectangle tool, Fill Stitch 4.5 line/mm, 45 degrees, under sewing on) and set only the line: Running Stitch, pitch 2.0 mm, 1 time. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record it in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json.

measurements.evidence: the fill reaches the 40 mm outline and the line is centred on it: 40 mm in all
PE-DESIGN 2,498; OpenStitch about 1.7 % fewer (the fill: 2,372 against 2,413)
